description: Your Company Search and Company Enrich tasks, newest first, with status, counts, cost, why each ended task stopped (completion_reason, coverage_limited), and the metadata labels set on company-search or company-enrich. Free; it lists your own tasks, not the companies they found (read those with company-search-status). People Search tasks are not listed here (see people-search-tasks). Use it to find a task_id (filter by type, status, or metadata to find the tasks of one campaign), or to see which tasks are still queued, running, or paused: a new task is refused while too many People Search and Company Search tasks are active.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page. Keep the same type, status, and metadata filters when you page.

metadata.description: Only tasks whose metadata has all of these key/value pairs (exact match, up to 3), example: {"campaign": "q4-outbound"}.

status.description: Only tasks in these statuses, example: ['running', 'paused'].

type.description: Only Company Search ('search') or only Company Enrich ('enrich') tasks.

name: company-search-tasks
title: List Company Search Tasks
